fact: The sector strategic plan 2024/25-2028/29 sets a target of 100% of the IECMS upgraded and operationalised, with an e-signature and online complaint added, and end users trained each year, while RIB services are decentralised to stations in 30 sectors and posts.
title: Justice, Reconciliation, Law & Order Sector Strategic Plan 2024/25-2028/29
